items.title: Playable Third Person controller
items.description: Camera-relative digital movement, directional turning, acceleration, braking and normalized diagonals in editable native C++.

items.title: Jumping and air control
items.description: Grounded Cross-button jumps, gravity, weaker airborne steering and bounded step-up for ledges.

items.title: Follow and orbit camera
items.description: Shoulder-button orbit and elevation, a following camera boom and gradual alignment behind forward travel. No camera-obstacle avoidance.

items.title: Walkable ramp surfaces
items.description: Slope rise and X/Z axis settings let movement follow a ramp's standing height. Height-field behavior, not general inclined-plane physics.

items.title: Lighter editable arena geometry
items.description: Reduced unnecessary subdivision keeps the generated greybox cheaper to draw while its seven mesh packages remain editable.

items.title: Three Scene editing modes
items.description: Separate 3D, world 2D and UI modes with domain-aware hierarchy filtering and context-preserving ancestors.

items.title: Signed-axis orientation control
items.description: Choose positive or negative X, Y or Z views while preserving the Scene View pivot and distance.

items.title: Placeable Actor class menu
items.description: Create reflected native or Blueprint Actor classes from domain-grouped Hierarchy menus, with compatible roots and defaults.

items.title: Actor hierarchy editing
items.description: Rename, duplicate, delete and logically reparent Actors. Branch operations include children; cross-domain conversion is not offered.

items.title: Compatible component authoring
items.description: Add/remove instance components through Inspector with root, inheritance, cardinality and required/excluded-component checks.

items.title: Actor and component property overrides
items.description: Edit reflected instance values and distinguish authored overrides from class defaults in Inspector.

items.title: Logical parenting and spatial attachment
items.description: Actor ownership/activation and component transform attachment have separate validated contracts and cycle checks.

items.title: Actor and Component Blueprint lifecycles
items.description: Begin Play, Tick and End Play for the new class families, alongside the existing Behaviour graph lifecycle.

items.title: Typed object references and Spawn Actor
items.description: ActorRef, ComponentRef, ObjectRef, Get Owner and bounded Actor spawning connect reflected class identity to visual gameplay.

items.title: Map Settings and Scene Blueprint editing
items.description: Edit the map-owned SceneScriptActor graph from Map Settings; validate class changes and compile with the project.

items.title: Same-map identity references
items.description: Scene graphs can target local Actors, Components and entities with checked identity, type and map ownership.

items.title: Cooked Actor tables and Level integration
items.description: Per-bank Actor/component/override/scene-script tables and bounded runtime instances. Dedicated console acceptance remains incomplete.

items.title: Actor runtime telemetry
items.description: Inspect alive, peak, rejected, spawned and deferred counts plus component, scene-script and loaded-bank counters.

items.title: World2D placement editor
items.description: Grid, pan, cursor-centered zoom, topmost picking and drag movement of labeled Actor footprints, with one undo step per drag.

items.title: Q12 2D transforms and Camera2D
items.description: Native parent-relative transforms, deterministic degree-based math and independent world/screen projection at 32 pixels per unit.

items.title: Stable 2D draw order and picking
items.description: Native layer, draw-order and creation-index sorting plus bounded picking helpers. The editor currently displays placement footprints.

items.title: Bounded 2D collision toolkit
items.description: Box/circle overlap, raycasts, sliding movement, masks and triggers. Sweeps are conservative; no rigid-body solver.

items.title: Automatic procedural UI construction preview
items.description: A native editor_preview hook shows code-created menus in UI mode without a MIPS build or gameplay lifecycle execution.

items.title: Interactive native UI preview
items.description: Optional navigation with Pause, Resume, Step and Restart in an isolated desktop process; cards are temporary and audio silent.

items.title: Shared desktop and PSX HUD compiler
items.description: The same bounded Q12 layout, clipping, text and nine-slice primitive compiler serves desktop preview and target rendering.

items.title: Portable audio roles and load modes
items.description: Sfx, Music, Ambience and Dialogue roles are independent of Auto, Resident and Stream residency; target incompatibility is explicit.

items.title: MIDI MusicSequence import
items.description: Import SMF 0/1 MIDI, retain original bytes and identity, inspect programs, tempo, note activity, loops and logical polyphony.

items.title: Editable portable SoundBanks
items.description: Map imported AudioClips to programs/key/velocity zones with tuning, pan, gain, envelopes and source-frame sample loops.

items.title: Retro Starter SoundBank
items.description: Generate an original MIT-provenance triangle sample and program-0 bank for a minimal music test. No hidden GM fallback.

items.title: Project default instrument bank
items.description: Explicit per-sequence bank selection or a project default, with dependency-aware invalidation when either changes.

items.title: SF2 and SF3 instrument libraries
items.description: Import compatible complete SoundFont libraries as one source-preserving bank; inspect required instruments, coverage and layers.

items.title: Bundled reference instrument library
items.description: Install the checksum-identified FluidR3Mono GM 2.315 library with its MIT notice from the sequence settings.

items.title: Musical v2 MIDI interpretation
items.description: Bank selection, RPN bend/fine/coarse tuning and supported controller semantics; old assets keep Legacy v1 until explicitly upgraded.

items.title: PSX music quality recipes
items.description: Compact/Balanced/High and Custom settings for rate, ADPCM effort, loops, release, filters, effects, headroom and budgets.

items.title: Cancellable conversion analysis
items.description: Analyze exact draft cook costs asynchronously, with contextual parameter help and no publication of a failed candidate.

items.title: Opt-in music budget optimizer
items.description: A bounded sample-rate search proposes a recipe. Adopt it into the draft explicitly, then save; required layers are not silently removed.

items.title: Source versus PSX Target audition
items.description: Compare original samples with actual cooked sequence/bank payloads after saving. Host Target Preview omits wet reverb and hardware latency.

items.title: Sequenced SPU music and SFX sharing
items.description: Four sequence instances, configurable music voice limits and priority/age allocation across the PSX's 24 physical voices.

items.title: Sequence memory and conversion reports
items.description: Separate sequence RAM, bank metadata/sample copies and SPU sample costs, with build-bound identities and adaptation diagnostics.

items.title: Acknowledged SPU DMA and batched note starts
items.description: Batched chord/layer key-ons, bounded transfer acknowledgements and reduced library modulation cadence address real-console playback costs.

items.title: Sony sequence and bank source inspection
items.description: Recognize supported SEQ/SEP and VAB layouts and preserve source parameters/companions. VAB instrument playback remains unavailable.

items.title: Manual PSX compilation
items.description: Edit without launching a MIPS build on every source change. Observation still refreshes resources and invalidates stale output.

items.title: Verified Play build reuse
items.description: PlayBuild.epokcache receipts allow executable/disc reuse only for matching scenes, profiles, resources, scripts and tracked inputs.

items.title: Selected scenes and initial bank
items.description: Build a chosen set of maps with inclusion checkboxes and an initial-scene choice, within the 16-bank total limit.

items.title: Build reports and artifact-size status
items.description: Memory reports enabled by default, open-last-report workflow and provenance-aware executable/external-data sizes with stale warnings.

items.title: Configurable runtime Debug HUD
items.description: Independent FPS, CPU, GTE, GPU command DMA and SPU sample-memory displays; metric definitions explicitly avoid utilization claims.

items.title: Position interpolation
items.description: Smooth supported entity/camera translations between fixed simulation steps; does not raise FPS or interpolate every visual system.

items.title: Scratchpad projected-vertex staging
items.description: Stage a chunk's projected vertices in the PSX scratchpad to reuse projection work without promising a universal speedup.

items.title: Persistent serial developer control
items.description: Owned resident/host sessions with acknowledged Pause, Continue and Reset, bounded timeouts and explicit resynchronization.

items.title: Bundled dependency Install / Repair
items.description: Guarded host setup verifies and restores bundled tools with progress, cancellation and installation locking.

items.title: macOS development shortcuts and tooling
items.description: Host-aware setup/profile scripts and optional Desktop shortcuts for the development editor; not a packaged app or a new reflection toolchain.

items.title: MCP Actor operations
items.description: scene_actors, scene_add_actor, scene_remove_actor and scene_set_actor extend the local authenticated editor interface to 24 tools.

items.title: Namespaced Actor CLI placement
items.description: --add-actor resolves native class names including namespaces and validates the destination map and Actor contract.
